title: UTNH-100 2026 official GPX
publisher: 可隆宁海越野挑战赛 / 上海穹景体育文化发展有限公司
claims: The official UTNH-100 2026 GPX is published on the organiser's OSS bucket as a direct .gpx file, without a licence or copyright statement.
The file contains 61,666 track points and, measured point to point with the haversine formula, 100.85 km of planar distance.
Track elevations range from 18 m to 909 m; raw point-to-point ascent and descent are +5,135 / −5,125 m without smoothing.
These figures are measurements of the file, not the official race-card values of 100.6 km and 4,986 m ascent/descent.

verification.checkedVia: curl.exe via local 7890 proxy; downloaded once to the agent workspace and measured locally, not hosted or redistributed
